i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyTmKZJMkiToyqhhN1Xq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BST2ThbpuTiyfeCUAKXQNL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r2/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;  // transferred with MPI_DOUBLE\n\n// 3D index calculation (global grid, serial layout)\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Part of the global grid owned by one rank. Storage carries one ghost layer on every side,\n// so owned cell (x,y,z) with 1 <= x <= n[0] (etc.) lives at at(x,y,z).\nstruct Block {\n    size_t n[3];       // owned cells per axis (always >= 1)\n    size_t lo[3];      // global coordinate of the first owned cell per axis\n    size_t stride[3];  // element strides of the local array\n\n    size_t at(size_t x, size_t y, size_t z) const { return x + y * stride[1] + z * stride[2]; }\n    size_t allocSize() const { return stride[2] * (n[2] + 2); }\n};\n\nBlock makeBlock(const int coords[3], const int dims[3], const size_t N[3]) {\n    Block b;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        b.lo[d] = N[d] * coords[d] / dims[d];\n        b.n[d] = N[d] * (coords[d] + 1) / dims[d] - b.lo[d];\n    }\n    b.stride[0] = 1;\n    b.stride[1] = b.n[0] + 2;\n    b.stride[2] = b.stride[1] * (b.n[1] + 2);\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Picks a 3D process grid (product == nprocs) that minimises the halo surface of a block.\n// Every process needs at least one cell per axis. Returns false if no such grid exists.\nbool chooseDims(int nprocs, const size_t N[3], int dims[3]) {\n    double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    bool found = false;\n    for (int a = 1; a <= nprocs; ++a) {\n        if (nprocs % a != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(a) > N[0]) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / a;\n        for (int b = 1; b <= rest; ++b) {\n            if (rest % b != 0) continue;\n            const int c = rest / b;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(b) > N[1] || static_cast<size_t>(c) > N[2]) continue;\n            const double bx = static_cast<double>(N[0]) / a;\n            const double by = static_cast<double>(N[1]) / b;\n            const double bz = static_cast<double>(N[2]) / c;\n            const double surface = (a > 1 ? by * bz : 0.0) + (b > 1 ? bx * bz : 0.0) + (c > 1 ? bx * by : 0.0);\n            if (surface < best) {\n                best = surface;\n                dims[0] = a;\n                dims[1] = b;\n                dims[2] = c;\n                found = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\n// Inclusive range of local owned-cell coordinates; empty if any axis has lo > hi.\nstruct Box {\n    long lo[3];\n    long hi[3];\n\n    bool empty() const { return lo[0] > hi[0] || lo[1] > hi[1] || lo[2] > hi[2]; }\n};\n\n// Owned cells that are updated by the stencil: global coordinates 1..N-2 on every axis.\nBox updateBox(const Block& b, const size_t N[3]) {\n    Box u;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        const long lo = static_cast<long>(b.lo[d]);\n        u.lo[d] = std::max(1L, 2L - lo);                                      // global >= 1\n        u.hi[d] = std::min(static_cast<long>(b.n[d]), static_cast<long>(N[d]) - 1 - lo);  // global <= N-2\n    }\n    return u;\n}\n\n// Splits the update box into the shell of cells on its six faces and the core in the middle.\n// Shell cells may read ghost data; core cells read owned data only. Together they partition u.\nstd::vector<Box> shellBoxes(const Box& u) {\n    std::vector<Box> shell;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        Box s = u;\n        for (int e = 0; e < d; ++e) {  // axes already covered by earlier planes are shrunk\n            s.lo[e] = u.lo[e] + 1;\n            s.hi[e] = u.hi[e] - 1;\n        }\n        s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.lo[d];\n        shell.push_back(s);\n        if (u.hi[d] > u.lo[d]) {\n            s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.hi[d];\n            shell.push_back(s);\n        }\n    }\n    return shell;\n}\n\n// Initial data depends only on the global index, exactly as in the serial version.\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& grid, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 1; z <= b.n[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y <= b.n[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x <= b.n[0]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.lo[0] + x - 1, b.lo[1] + y - 1, b.lo[2] + z - 1, nx, ny);\n                grid[b.at(x, y, z)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil over a box of owned cells. Same summation order as the serial code.\nvoid stencilBox(const Real* __restrict input, Real* __restrict output, const Block& b, const Box& box) {\n    if (box.empty()) return;\n    const size_t sy = b.stride[1];\n    const size_t sz = b.stride[2];\n    for (long z = box.lo[2]; z <= box.hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (long y = box.lo[1]; y <= box.hi[1]; ++y) {\n            const size_t row = b.at(box.lo[0], y, z);\n            const size_t end = row + static_cast<size_t>(box.hi[0] - box.lo[0]);\n            for (size_t c = row; c <= end; ++c) {\n                output[c] = (input[c] + input[c - 1] + input[c + 1] + input[c - sy] + input[c + sy] +\n                             input[c - sz] + input[c + sz]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calls visit(index) for each cell of the plane at local coordinate `pos` along `axis`\n// (owned or ghost layer). The order depends only on the block shape, so a packed face\n// unpacks correctly on the neighbour, which has the same extents in the other two axes.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachPlaneCell(const Block& b, int axis, size_t pos, Visit&& visit) {\n    size_t lo[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    size_t hi[3] = {b.n[0], b.n[1], b.n[2]};\n    lo[axis] = hi[axis] = pos;\n    for (size_t z = lo[2]; z <= hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = lo[1]; y <= hi[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = lo[0]; x <= hi[0]; ++x) {\n                visit(b.at(x, y, z));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Non-blocking exchange of the six face halos with the Cartesian neighbours.\n// Face f = 2*axis + side (side 0 = low, 1 = high). Faces without a neighbour\n// (MPI_PROC_NULL, i.e. the global domain boundary) are skipped.\nclass HaloExchange {\n  public:\n    HaloExchange(MPI_Comm comm, const int* neighbours, const Block& b) : comm_(comm) {\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            nb_[f] = neighbours[f];\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            size_t count = 1;\n            for (int e = 0; e < 3; ++e) {\n                if (e != axis) count *= b.n[e];\n            }\n            send_[f].resize(count);\n            recv_[f].resize(count);\n        }\n        std::fill(req_, req_ + 12, MPI_REQUEST_NULL);\n    }\n\n    // Packs the owned boundary planes of `a` and posts the receives and sends.\n    void start(const Real* a, const Block& b) {\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            if (nb_[f] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            const size_t pos = (f % 2 == 0) ? 1 : b.n[axis];  // owned plane facing the neighbour\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { send_[f][p++] = a[c]; });\n            const int count = static_cast<int>(send_[f].size());\n            // The neighbour sends its face facing us with tag f^1, and we send ours with tag f.\n            MPI_Irecv(recv_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f ^ 1, comm_, &req_[2 * f]);\n            MPI_Isend(send_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f, comm_, &req_[2 * f + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Waits for all transfers and unpacks the received planes into the ghost layer of `a`.\n    void finish(Real* a, const Block& b) {\n        MPI_Waitall(12, req_, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            if (nb_[f] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            const size_t pos = (f % 2 == 0) ? 0 : b.n[axis] + 1;  // ghost plane on this face\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { a[c] = recv_[f][p++]; });\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    MPI_Comm comm_;\n    int nb_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> send_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> recv_[6];\n    MPI_Request req_[12];\n};\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n\n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank, so all ranks take the same path)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Error: grid dimensions must be at least 1\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const size_t N[3] = {nx, ny, nz};\n    int dims[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    if (!chooseDims(nprocs, N, dims)) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: cannot decompose %zu x %zu x %zu grid over %d processes\\n\", nx, ny, nz, nprocs);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI processes: %d (%d x %d x %d)\\n\", nprocs, dims[0], dims[1], dims[2]);\n    }\n\n    // Cartesian topology; Storage carries one ghost layer on every side,\n// so owned cell (x,y,z) with 1 <= x <= n[0] (etc.) lives at at(x,y,z).\nstruct Block {\n    size_t n[3];       // owned cells per axis (always >= 1)\n    size_t lo[3];      // global coordinate of the first owned cell per axis\n    size_t stride[3];  // element strides of the local array\n\n    size_t at(size_t x, size_t y, size_t z) const { return x + y * stride[1] + z * stride[2]; }\n    size_t allocSize() const { return stride[2] * (n[2] + 2); }\n};\n\nBlock makeBlock(const int coords[3], const int dims[3], const size_t N[3]) {\n    Block b;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        b.lo[d] = N[d] * coords[d] / dims[d];\n        b.n[d] = N[d] * (coords[d] + 1) / dims[d] - b.lo[d];\n    }\n    b.stride[0] = 1;\n    b.stride[1] = b.n[0] + 2;\n    b.stride[2] = b.stride[1] * (b.n[1] + 2);\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Picks a 3D process grid (product == nprocs) that minimises the halo surface of a block.\n// Every process needs at least one cell per axis. Returns false if no such grid exists.\nbool chooseDims(int nprocs, const size_t N[3], int dims[3]) {\n    double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    bool found = false;\n    for (int a = 1; a <= nprocs; ++a) {\n        if (nprocs % a != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(a) > N[0]) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / a;\n        for (int b = 1; b <= rest; ++b) {\n            if (rest % b != 0) continue;\n            const int c = rest / b;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(b) > N[1] || static_cast<size_t>(c) > N[2]) continue;\n            const double bx = static_cast<double>(N[0]) / a;\n            const double by = static_cast<double>(N[1]) / b;\n            const double bz = static_cast<double>(N[2]) / c;\n            const double surface = (a > 1 ? by * bz : 0.0) + (b > 1 ? bx * bz : 0.0) + (c > 1 ? bx * by : 0.0);\n            if (surface < best) {\n                best = surface;\n                dims[0] = a;\n                dims[1] = b;\n                dims[2] = c;\n                found = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\n// Inclusive range of local owned-cell coordinates; empty if any axis has lo > hi.\nstruct Box {\n    long lo[3];\n    long hi[3];\n\n    bool empty() const { return lo[0] > hi[0] || lo[1] > hi[1] || lo[2] > hi[2]; }\n};\n\n// Owned cells that are updated by the stencil: global coordinates 1..N-2 on every axis.\nBox updateBox(const Block& b, const size_t N[3]) {\n    Box u;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        const long lo = static_cast<long>(b.lo[d]);\n        u.lo[d] = std::max(1L, 2L - lo);                                      // global >= 1\n        u.hi[d] = std::min(static_cast<long>(b.n[d]), static_cast<long>(N[d]) - 1 - lo);  // global <= N-2\n    }\n    return u;\n}\n\n// Splits the update box into the shell of cells on its six faces and the core in the middle.\n// Shell cells may read ghost data; core cells read owned data only. Together they partition u.\nstd::vector<Box> shellBoxes(const Box& u) {\n    std::vector<Box> shell;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        Box s = u;\n        for (int e = 0; e < d; ++e) {  // axes already covered by earlier planes are shrunk\n            s.lo[e] = u.lo[e] + 1;\n            s.hi[e] = u.hi[e] - 1;\n        }\n        s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.lo[d];\n        shell.push_back(s);\n        if (u.hi[d] > u.lo[d]) {\n            s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.hi[d];\n            shell.push_back(s);\n        }\n    }\n    return shell;\n}\n\n// Initial data depends only on the global index, exactly as in the serial version.\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& grid, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 1; z <= b.n[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y <= b.n[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x <= b.n[0]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.lo[0] + x - 1, b.lo[1] + y - 1, b.lo[2] + z - 1, nx, ny);\n                grid[b.at(x, y, z)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil over a box of owned cells. Same summation order as the serial code.\nvoid stencilBox(const Real* __restrict input, Real* __restrict output, const Block& b, const Box& box) {\n    if (box.empty()) return;\n    const size_t sy = b.stride[1];\n    const size_t sz = b.stride[2];\n    for (long z = box.lo[2]; z <= box.hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (long y = box.lo[1]; y <= box.hi[1]; ++y) {\n            const size_t row = b.at(box.lo[0], y, z);\n            const size_t end = row + static_cast<size_t>(box.hi[0] - box.lo[0]);\n            for (size_t c = row; c <= end; ++c) {\n                output[c] = (input[c] + input[c - 1] + input[c + 1] + input[c - sy] + input[c + sy] +\n                             input[c - sz] + input[c + sz]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calls visit(index) for each cell of the plane at local coordinate `pos` along `axis`\n// (owned or ghost layer). The order depends only on the block shape, so a packed face\n// unpacks correctly on the neighbour, which has the same extents in the other two axes.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachPlaneCell(const Block& b, int axis, size_t pos, Visit&& visit) {\n    size_t lo[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    size_t hi[3] = {b.n[0], b.n[1], b.n[2]};\n    lo[axis] = hi[axis] = pos;\n    for (size_t z = lo[2]; z <= hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = lo[1]; y <= hi[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = lo[0]; x <= hi[0]; ++x) {\n                visit(b.at(x, y, z));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Non-blocking exchange of the six face halos with the Cartesian neighbours.\n// Face f = 2*axis + side (side 0 = low, 1 = high). Faces without a neighbour\n// (MPI_PROC_NULL, i.e. the global domain boundary) are skipped.\nclass HaloExchange {\n  public:\n    HaloExchange(MPI_Comm comm, const int* neighbours, const Block& b) : comm_(comm) {\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            nb_[f] = neighbours[f];\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            size_t count = 1;\n            for (int e = 0; e < 3; ++e) {\n                if (e != axis) count *= b.n[e];\n            }\n            send_[f].resize(count);\n            recv_[f].resize(count);\n        }\n        std::fill(req_, req_ + 12, MPI_REQUEST_NULL);\n    }\n\n    // Packs the owned boundary planes of `a` and posts the receives and sends.\n    void start(const Real* a, const Block& b) {\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            if (nb_[f] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            const size_t pos = (f % 2 == 0) ? 1 : b.n[axis];  // owned plane facing the neighbour\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { send_[f][p++] = a[c]; });\n            const int count = static_cast<int>(send_[f].size());\n            // The neighbour sends its face facing us with tag f^1, and we send ours with tag f.\n            MPI_Irecv(recv_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f ^ 1, comm_, &req_[2 * f]);\n            MPI_Isend(send_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f, comm_, &req_[2 * f + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Waits for all transfers and unpacks the received planes into the ghost layer of `a`.\n    void finish(Real* a, const Block& b) {\n        MPI_Waitall(12, req_, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            if (nb_[f] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            const size_t pos = (f % 2 == 0) ? 0 : b.n[axis] + 1;  // ghost plane on this face\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { a[c] = recv_[f][p++]; });\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    MPI_Comm comm_;\n    int nb_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> send_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> recv_[6];\n    MPI_Request req_[12];\n};\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n\n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {\n                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                    output[idx] = input[idx];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? grid1 : grid2;\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01BST2ThbpuTiyfeCUAKXQNL","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Storage carries one ghost layer on every side,\n// so owned cell (x,y,z) with 1 <= x <= n[0] (etc.) lives at at(x,y,z).\nstruct Block {\n    size_t n[3];       // owned cells per axis (always >= 1)\n    size_t lo[3];      // global coordinate of the first owned cell per axis\n    size_t stride[3];  // element strides of the local array\n\n    size_t at(size_t x, size_t y, size_t z) const { return x + y * stride[1] + z * stride[2]; }\n    size_t allocSize() const { return stride[2] * (n[2] + 2); }\n};\n\nBlock makeBlock(const int coords[3], const int dims[3], const size_t N[3]) {\n    Block b;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        b.lo[d] = N[d] * coords[d] / dims[d];\n        b.n[d] = N[d] * (coords[d] + 1) / dims[d] - b.lo[d];\n    }\n    b.stride[0] = 1;\n    b.stride[1] = b.n[0] + 2;\n    b.stride[2] = b.stride[1] * (b.n[1] + 2);\n    return b;\n}\n\n// Picks a 3D process grid (product == nprocs) that minimises the halo surface of a block.\n// Every process needs at least one cell per axis. Returns false if no such grid exists.\nbool chooseDims(int nprocs, const size_t N[3], int dims[3]) {\n    double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    bool found = false;\n    for (int a = 1; a <= nprocs; ++a) {\n        if (nprocs % a != 0 || static_cast<size_t>(a) > N[0]) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / a;\n        for (int b = 1; b <= rest; ++b) {\n            if (rest % b != 0) continue;\n            const int c = rest / b;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(b) > N[1] || static_cast<size_t>(c) > N[2]) continue;\n            const double bx = static_cast<double>(N[0]) / a;\n            const double by = static_cast<double>(N[1]) / b;\n            const double bz = static_cast<double>(N[2]) / c;\n            const double surface = (a > 1 ? by * bz : 0.0) + (b > 1 ? bx * bz : 0.0) + (c > 1 ? bx * by : 0.0);\n            if (surface < best) {\n                best = surface;\n                dims[0] = a;\n                dims[1] = b;\n                dims[2] = c;\n                found = true;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\n// Inclusive range of local owned-cell coordinates; empty if any axis has lo > hi.\nstruct Box {\n    long lo[3];\n    long hi[3];\n\n    bool empty() const { return lo[0] > hi[0] || lo[1] > hi[1] || lo[2] > hi[2]; }\n};\n\n// Owned cells that are updated by the stencil: global coordinates 1..N-2 on every axis.\nBox updateBox(const Block& b, const size_t N[3]) {\n    Box u;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        const long lo = static_cast<long>(b.lo[d]);\n        u.lo[d] = std::max(1L, 2L - lo);                                      // global >= 1\n        u.hi[d] = std::min(static_cast<long>(b.n[d]), static_cast<long>(N[d]) - 1 - lo);  // global <= N-2\n    }\n    return u;\n}\n\n// Splits the update box into the shell of cells on its six faces and the core in the middle.\n// Shell cells may read ghost data; core cells read owned data only. Together they partition u.\nstd::vector<Box> shellBoxes(const Box& u) {\n    std::vector<Box> shell;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {\n        Box s = u;\n        for (int e = 0; e < d; ++e) {  // axes already covered by earlier planes are shrunk\n            s.lo[e] = u.lo[e] + 1;\n            s.hi[e] = u.hi[e] - 1;\n        }\n        s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.lo[d];\n        shell.push_back(s);\n        if (u.hi[d] > u.lo[d]) {\n            s.lo[d] = s.hi[d] = u.hi[d];\n            shell.push_back(s);\n        }\n    }\n    return shell;\n}\n\n// Initial data depends only on the global index, exactly as in the serial version.\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& grid, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 1; z <= b.n[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y <= b.n[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x <= b.n[0]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.lo[0] + x - 1, b.lo[1] + y - 1, b.lo[2] + z - 1, nx, ny);\n                grid[b.at(x, y, z)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil over a box of owned cells. Same summation order as the serial code.\nvoid stencilBox(const Real* __restrict input, Real* __restrict output, const Block& b, const Box& box) {\n    if (box.empty()) return;\n    const size_t sy = b.stride[1];\n    const size_t sz = b.stride[2];\n    for (long z = box.lo[2]; z <= box.hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (long y = box.lo[1]; y <= box.hi[1]; ++y) {\n            const size_t row = b.at(box.lo[0], y, z);\n            const size_t end = row + static_cast<size_t>(box.hi[0] - box.lo[0]);\n            for (size_t c = row; c <= end; ++c) {\n                output[c] = (input[c] + input[c - 1] + input[c + 1] + input[c - sy] + input[c + sy] +\n                             input[c - sz] + input[c + sz]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calls visit(index) for each cell of the plane at local coordinate `pos` along `axis`\n// (owned or ghost layer). The order depends only on the block shape, so a packed face\n// unpacks correctly on the neighbour, which has the same extents in the other two axes.\ntemplate <typename Visit>\nvoid forEachPlaneCell(const Block& b, int axis, size_t pos, Visit&& visit) {\n    size_t lo[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    size_t hi[3] = {b.n[0], b.n[1], b.n[2]};\n    lo[axis] = hi[axis] = pos;\n    for (size_t z = lo[2]; z <= hi[2]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = lo[1]; y <= hi[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = lo[0]; x <= hi[0]; ++x) {\n                visit(b.at(x, y, z));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Non-blocking exchange of the six face halos with the Cartesian neighbours.\n// Face f = 2*axis + side (side 0 = low, 1 = high). 1 : b.n[axis];  // owned plane facing the neighbour\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { send_[f][p++] = a[c]; });\n            const int count = static_cast<int>(send_[f].size());\n            // The neighbour sends its face facing us with tag f^1, and we send ours with tag f.\n            MPI_Irecv(recv_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f ^ 1, comm_, &req_[2 * f]);\n            MPI_Isend(send_[f].data(), count, MPI_DOUBLE, nb_[f], f, comm_, &req_[2 * f + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Waits for all transfers and unpacks the received planes into the ghost layer of `a`.\n    void finish(Real* a, const Block& b) {\n        MPI_Waitall(12, req_, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        for (int f = 0; f < 6; ++f) {\n            if (nb_[f] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;\n            const int axis = f / 2;\n            const size_t pos = (f % 2 == 0) ? 0 : b.n[axis] + 1;  // ghost plane on this face\n            size_t p = 0;\n            forEachPlaneCell(b, axis, pos, [&](size_t c) { a[c] = recv_[f][p++]; });\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    MPI_Comm comm_;\n    int nb_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> send_[6];\n    std::vector<Real> recv_[6];\n    MPI_Request req_[12];\n};\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n\n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Error: grid dimensions must be at least 1\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const size_t N[3] = {nx, ny, nz};\n    int dims[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    if (!chooseDims(nprocs, N, dims)) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: cannot decompose %zu x %zu x %zu grid over %d processes\\n\", nx, ny, nz, nprocs);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI processes: %d (%d x %d x %d)\\n\", nprocs, dims[0], dims[1], dims[2]);\n    }\n\n    // Cartesian topology; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyUaSr9yjZENttbGb6kQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs under MPI, and its output matches the original serial program exactly. Every checked configuration gives the same results block (sum, min/max, samples, hash) and the same validation verdict.\n\n**What changed (only `stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp` and `stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt`):**\n\n- **Decomposition:** a 3D Cartesian grid, chosen to minimise halo surface for the given `-x/-y/-z`. Each rank owns a block with one ghost layer per side.\n- **Halo exchange:** non-blocking, one packed message per face. Each iteration overlaps communication with the interior update; the boundary shell is computed after the halos arrive.\n- **Correctness:** the per-cell arithmetic and summation order are unchanged, and boundary cells are never written, as in the original. The final grid is gathered to rank 0 so the existing sum/hash/sample/validation code runs on the full grid.\n- **Scaling:** on a 256³ grid, 20 iterations, the rate went from 652 to 3767 MCellUpdates/s going from 1 to 8 ranks.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX` unconditionally. The executable name is unchanged, and the build is warning-free under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Verification:** I built the original as a reference and compared `-r -v` output for 10 grid shapes (including 1×1×1, 2-cell, non-cubic and zero-iteration cases) at 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 ranks, 70 combinations in all, with zero mismatches. I also checked 24 and 64 ranks on a non-cubic 96×80×72 grid; both match.\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit:**\n\n- **Extra output line:** I added `MPI processes: <used> of <total> (x × y × z)` after the header. Everything else is unchanged, but this line is new if anything parses the output.\n- **Too many ranks:** if the grid is too small for the rank count (fewer cells than ranks along an axis), the extra ranks sit idle instead of erroring. The results are unchanged.\n- **Zero-sized grid:** `-x 0` (or `-y`/`-z`) now prints an error and exits 1. The original had undefined behaviour there.\n- **Memory:** rank 0 holds the full grid (plus a staging copy) to produce the original output format. That gather is outside the timed region but is O(N) on one rank.\n- **Limits:** the gather uses `int` counts, so the grid is limited to under 2³¹ cells.\n\n**Not tested:** multi-node runs. All tests were on a single 256-core machine using `--oversubscribe` up to 64 ranks.\n\nI did not commit, since you didn't ask me to, and there is no git repository here anyway."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1062,"cache_read_input_tokens":74365,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1062},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"98d2942d-382a-43da-96dd-8633a8444986","uuid":"0c0f8b81-f566-4432-a3fd-1d814a1cc79f","timestamp":"2026-10-13T02:50:25.750Z","request_id":"req_011CfyUaSXofDTiLWJ24Svoq"}
